spec.description: Dashboard for Personal Knowledge OS — Observability

spec.title: Non-LLM stage latency p95 by stage
spec.description: Self-time of non-LLM /query stages (nested stages excluded). Quantiles from few samples are rough: on sparse traffic treat p95 as indicative only.

spec.title: LLM call latency p95 by stage
spec.description: Successful LLM calls only, by pipeline stage. Quantiles from few samples are rough: on sparse traffic treat p95 as indicative only.

spec.title: Tokens per minute by stage and type
spec.description: Prompt and completion tokens per minute, all providers and sources.

spec.title: Estimated token share
spec.description: Share of tokens approximated from text length (provider reported no usage) over the dashboard range. No data when no tokens were used.

spec.title: Query outcomes over time
spec.description: Served /query requests per second by outcome.

spec.title: Cache-hit ratio
spec.description: cached / all outcomes over the dashboard range.

spec.title: Abstain rate
spec.description: abstain (insufficient context) / all outcomes over the dashboard range.

spec.title: Low-confidence rate
spec.description: answer_low_confidence (citation check failed) / all outcomes over the dashboard range. Cached hits are in the denominator.

spec.title: Prompt version
spec.description: Prompt bundle version currently exposed by the app.

spec.title: /query availability (28d SLO: 99%)
spec.description: Share of /query responses that were not 5xx over the 28-day SLO window (provisional).

spec.title: Availability error budget remaining (28d)
spec.description: 1 - (5xx ratio / 1% budget). Below 0 means the budget is spent.

spec.title: /query latency (28d SLO: 95% within 10 s)
spec.description: Share of /query requests that completed within 10 s over the 28-day SLO window (provisional).

spec.title: Latency error budget remaining (28d)
spec.description: 1 - (share over 10 s / 5% budget). Below 0 means the budget is spent.
